protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1AbuseReason.description:
AbuseReason is the reporter-selected category used to triage the operator
queue. Free-form context belongs in ReportSiteRequest.details.

disabledReason.description:
Why a builtin ships dark. Surfaced so a disabled rule is never mistaken
for a healthy one.

note.description: Plain-language statement of what the numbers below do and do not cover.

v1DiagnosticsCoverage.description:
DiagnosticsCoverage is how much of this instance's activity we can actually
see. Without it, "few requests" and "we cannot see this customer's requests"
look identical on the page.

membershipsUnavailable.description: True when the platform database could not be read.

identityUnavailable.description: True when the identity schema could not be read.

membersUnavailable.description: Sections fail independently. Unavailable must never be displayed as none.

workload.description: Identity only when workload_missing or snapshot_unavailable is true.

workloadMissing.description: Missing from a successfully collected current snapshot, not a 404.

eventsSince.description: Inclusive bounds used for related_events, preserved even for empty results.

organizationId.description:
Every workforce connection belongs to exactly one Everstack organization.
Empty is possible only for legacy rows that must be assigned before use.

v1IdentityConnectionSummary.description:
Identity connections are upstream workforce OIDC providers used by the
Everstack-native Cloud login UI. Secrets are write-only and never appear in
this control-plane representation.

v1IdentityLinkage.description:
- IDENTITY_LINKAGE_UNSPECIFIED: No linkage classification was supplied.
 - IDENTITY_LINKAGE_LINKED: An identity record joined to a platform user.
 - IDENTITY_LINKAGE_IDENTITY_ONLY: Signed up but never became a platform user.
 - IDENTITY_LINKAGE_PLATFORM_ONLY: A platform user with no current native identity link, for example a
WorkOS-era account.

v1IdentityOverview.description:
Identity records describe human authentication state only. Organization
memberships, product roles, billing, and instance access remain in the
Everstack platform model and are intentionally not editable here.

v1ImpactCertainty.description:
- IMPACT_CERTAINTY_DIRECT: Authoritative placement ties this instance to the component.
 - IMPACT_CERTAINTY_POTENTIAL: A shared service every instance in the environment depends on. This is
not proof that any one customer is affected.
 - IMPACT_CERTAINTY_UNMAPPED: No relationship can be established from stored metadata. Never display
this as "unaffected".

fingerprint.description:
Dedupe key. A condition repeating every ten seconds updates one row
rather than creating thousands, and this is what identifies it.

value.description: Absent when the incident is not threshold-based.

occurrenceCount.description:
How many times the condition has been observed. Large numbers here are
normal and are the point: they mean dedupe is working.

dataSourceId.description: Names the data source whose control plane owns this incident.

assignedTo.description:
Human workflow, deliberately separate from `status`, which is the observed
condition. A recurrence re-fires the condition; it must not erase that
somebody had taken ownership.

updatedAt.description:
Optimistic-concurrency token. A mutation sends back the value it last saw
so a second operator cannot silently overwrite the first.

kind.title: fired | escalated | notified | acknowledged | snoozed | resolved | comment

runsAvailable.description:
True only when execution history can be attributed to this automation.
False on legacy schemas or when older runs lack exact schedule provenance.

startedAt.description: Absent when the source ledger records only completion, as sandbox ledgers do.

v1InstanceErrorGroup.description:
InstanceErrorGroup is one failure message and how often it occurred.

Deliberately not classified into categories: the telemetry carries no
normalized error type, so grouping by message reports what happened, while
deriving categories from the free-text message would mislabel every message
whose wording changes.

hostedSiteCountAvailable.description:
False when hosting data is isolated in a separate database and cannot be
joined to this platform instance record.

identityUnavailable.description: True when the identity schema could not be read.

firingCritical.description:
Counts across the whole open set, not just this page, so the console can
show an accurate badge without fetching everything.

v1ModerationActionStatus.description:
- MODERATION_ACTION_STATUS_APPLIED: The serving provider accepted the write. This does not claim that an
eventually-consistent KV update is already visible at every edge.
 - MODERATION_ACTION_STATUS_SUPERSEDED: A newer decision for the same site replaced this action before it could
be projected. Superseded actions are retained for audit but never retried.

lastDeliveredAt.description: Delivery health, so a target that has silently stopped working is visible.

instancesWithMeasuredHealth.description:
Healthy and degraded counts are meaningful only for instances whose
health has actually been measured.

instancesNeverHealthChecked.description:
Until EVS-57 lands, this equals the live instance count because no health
measurements are written.

detail.description:
Sanitized explanation. This must never include a DSN, credential, or raw
driver error that could contain either.

healthy.description: Per EVS-57, healthy is only meaningful when last_health_check is set.

v1OrganizationInvitationRow.description: SECURITY: The secret invite token is deliberately absent. NEVER add it here.

workspaceAccessRestricted.description: True when the organization has workspaces the user is not a member of.

hostedSiteCountAvailable.description:
False when hosting data is isolated in a separate database and cannot be
joined to the platform organization inventory.

v1Site.description: Site is a hosted static site served at {slug}.evs.run.

v1SiteAccess.description:
SiteAccess controls indexing/visibility of a site. Anonymous sites are
always served with noindex regardless of this value.

v1SiteStatus.description: SiteStatus is the lifecycle state of a hosted site.

v1SourceState.description:
- SOURCE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE: UNAVAILABLE means the probe failed. Do not collapse it into
NOT_CONFIGURED: a configured source that cannot be reached needs action.
 - SOURCE_STATE_NOT_CONFIGURED: NOT_CONFIGURED means this deployment does not have the source.

directCount.description:
Counts describe the exact returned instance set. If the complete set
exceeds the response bound, impact_unavailable is true instead.

mappingAsOf.description: Collection time of the snapshot used to identify the component.

accessSource.description:
explicit is a workspace_members row; implicit is owner/admin access, as
defined by services/auth/internal/service/organization_service.go.
